verses.author: model_A
verses.text: The market empties out and the pigeons take the square.

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
Grey wings settle where
coins changed hands an hour ago—
someone forgot the bread crumbs.

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
A dog noses the crust
left beneath an empty crate,
the pigeons scatter, resettle.

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
Evening pulls the shutters down early now,
the crate stays empty till the next dawn's counting—
something always circles back to feed.

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
The moon rolls up
over the folded awnings—
a coin no one spends tonight.

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
Cold light on the cobbles,
counting nothing but its own reflection—
morning will make change of it.

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
Steam rises off the coffee cart,
the vendor breathes into his hands—
the day opens like a fist unclenching.

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
Sparrows argue over a crust
in the gutter's thin gold—
the whole street pays attention.

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
A bicycle bell rings once,
someone's late for something—
the sparrows don't even look up.

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
The delivery man leaves his engine running,
ducks in for one more coffee—
the whole morning waits on him.

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
A pigeon steps into the idling exhaust,
warms its feet on someone else's hurry—
patience, it turns out, is just bad timing.

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
The steam from his cup fogs the window,
outside a life keeps idling—
even waiting has somewhere to be.

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
The traffic light forgets itself,
stays green for no one—
even patience gets tired of waiting.

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
Somewhere a kettle clicks off by itself,
no one home to hear it—
the room fills with a silence that was already there.

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
The clock on the stove blinks noon forever,
no one left to reset it—
time keeps its own small failures private.

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
Dust settles on the unturned page,
the bookmark holds a place
no one is coming back to.
